paddle.source_pin: [I] Mill-Max 0933-0-15-20-72-14-11-0 data sheet (mm.digikey.com/Volume0/opasdata/d220001/medias/docus/7171/0933-0-15-20-72-14-11-0.pdf, updated 8/8/25): 45 gf at mid stroke, stroke 1.397 mm, 6 A (4.80 A derated), 40 mOhm max, press-fit into an insulator, hole 1.600 mm max
paddle.source_spring: [I] Century Spring CF37CS (https://www.centuryspring.com/shop/cf37cs, read 2026-11-06): constant force 0.37 lb = 1.65 N, drum 6.4 mm, 4.75 x 0.08 mm strip 304.8 mm, hole 3.25 mm, $2.82; the page gives no load tolerance: +/- 10 % assumed (BLOCKER, BT1 measures it)
paddle.window: constant force over the whole 0 to 40 mm push (the sim's docked pushes were 2.6 to 30.3 mm, acc10), any yaw the swivel takes (+/- 10 deg), any lateral and vertical error inside the strips: each pin carries F/6

old.design: 2 x 37.5 N/m compression springs, no preload, 6 x 0932 at 0.59 N
old.note: 0.5 to 2.3 N over the sim's 7 to 30 mm pushes against 3.53 N needed: short pushes left the pins at 0.08 to 0.4 N

paddle.face_contact: the tips stand 1.05 mm proud; at the nominal 3.29 N each pin is pressed 0.87 to 1.04 mm (mid stroke is 0.699 mm), so the face stays 0.01 mm or more off the chest; the face is only an over-travel stop at 75 % of the stroke

duck.note: the paddle pushes the chest back with at most 3.62 N (the old paddle 3.0 N at full travel, 1.3 N at the 17 mm mean push); the belly on the seat (7 to 22 N, sim) must hold it: friction 0.52 or more at the lightest sit (BLOCKER 10 and BT9; the sim uses 1.0)

cf_setup.note: [I] a constant-force spring reaches its load after about 1.25 drum diameters of extension (Century Spring constant force spring design guide, general rule; BT1 checks it); 12 mm at rest

seat.spring: [I] Century Spring CC-28CS (https://www.centuryspring.com/shop/cc-28cs, read 2026-11-06): music wire, OD 7.14 mm, ID 6.12 mm, free 23.88 mm, 0.25 N/mm, solid 6.1 mm, max deflection 17.78 mm, max load 4.45 N, $2.81
seat.switch: [I] Omron D2F-01L (https://omronfs.omron.com/en_US/ecb/products/pdf/en-d2f.pdf): hinge lever OF max 0.78 N, OT min 0.55 mm, FP max 10 mm, OP 6.8 +/- 1.5 mm
seat.closes: the switch closes at 5.0 of the 6.0 mm of travel at the nominal OP (the slots give +/- 2 mm to set it at BT5); the seat bottoms on its walls at 5.9 N in all; a seated duck puts 7 to 22 N on it (sim), so it is always fully down and at 112 mm
seat.old: the old text asked for 8 to 12 N to close: above the sim's lightest sit (7 N), and the old seat top floated at 112 mm with no spring named and no actuator for the switch

charge.source: [I] MCP73213 EV board user's guide DS51849A (ww1.microchip.com/downloads/en/DeviceDoc/51849A.pdf): preset 500 mA, 1000 mA with the PROG via to ground; 10 % termination; U1 MCP73213-A6S/MF (BOM table B-1); 1100 mA needs R_PROG 1.00 k (table 2-1)
charge.pick: 1.0 A: the PROG via tied to ground on the shipped board (no resistor change)

doc_scaled.note: DOCK_TWIN 11.3's charge_awake runs (4.3 h and 2.4 h at 1.1 A, with SYS carrying the load) scaled by this model's ratio

tipping.slide: the push 3.6 N against the dock's weight 22.3 N: friction 0.16 needed (rubber feet; under the walk-in only)

label: calc only; pin, spring and switch values read from the pages named in each entry
